fixed_rules.atr_stop_definition: Wilder ATR(14) on locked 15-minute signal timeframe; latest completed bar at fill

precommitted_lock_rule.eligible_cell: Sharpe > 0, PF > 1, trade_count >= 20, expectancy >= 80 percent of baseline, and absolute max DD <= baseline in both IS and Validation
precommitted_lock_rule.stable_zone: at least 3 adjacent eligible values in the ordered one-dimensional grid
precommitted_lock_rule.modified_lock: if a stable zone exists, lock its parameter medoid; ties use the lower parameter value
precommitted_lock_rule.baseline_lock: if no stable zone exists, retain the frozen baseline exit
